_comment: Bots on Cloudflare Workers that track bot-core main. A push to main deploys the canary first (built against that exact commit), waits until its /healthz reports the same sha and passes, then deploys every fleet entry. Each repo must have wrangler.jsonc on the listed branch and depend on thebooleanjulian-bot-core. See .github/workflows/propagate-workers.yml for the secrets it needs.
